renderContract.materialPolicy: Apply copied materials to every occupied original mesh slot, including initially hidden objects; reuse those material bindings for every construction cut.
renderContract.cumulativeSelector: For each existing sequence n, show canonical source objects with preserved reviewStage <= n, respecting explicit source hidden-object policy; do not derive new process IDs.
renderContract.cameraPolicy: One fixed approved complete-building camera, resolution, scale, lighting, world and exposure for every stage of that building. Do not refit each partial stage.
renderContract.emptyStagePolicy: Keep existing process ID and order even when visible geometry repeats; reuse the prior selector/render with an explicit reason. No invented components or learning credit.
renderContract.contextPolicy: Unresolved process/context paving retains null processId and original reviewStage; separately report it and its render visibility.
renderContract.caveat: Existing produce.construction references production base verification and lock; adapt to R16 candidate paths and include separately authorized visual proxy objects without changing original mapping.

runtimeExportContract.semantics: delta_only; each process asset must contain exactly its verified policy delta; cumulative display unions prior process assets.
gates: No-new-geometry stages retain prior selectors and no fabricated asset.
Context and standalone variants require separate contracts.
Rendering must not grant credit, auto-complete or imply runtime promotion.
Current app assets/manifests remain outside this audit.

existingExporterNativeHashGuard.r16Compatibility: Existing exporter rejects R16 material derivative hashes; a separately verified and explicitly bound derivative contract is required.

selectorAuthorityWarning: Canonical review GLB map and original R12 curriculum display policy are different source snapshots. Keep IDs/order intact; do not silently substitute their member selections.
notes: Eleven buildings have 128 canonical review cuts. Gates add 32 instance cuts, giving 160; duplicated left/right hyeopmun uses the same six logical process IDs, so catalog contains 154 unique processes.
Runtime approved art series count and Sarang sequence are independent catalogs; the full native process catalog is absent from the inspected main assets/data.
gokgan and north/south toilets have native process cuts but no corresponding approved runtime stage-art series in the inspected JSONs.
Current maintained warm-stone worktree tool/hanok_scene has older export/render helpers; R12 process delivery tool snapshot is under canonical/sources/app-export-tools.
